data.one_liner: Compare two images with a slider, handle, zoom, pan, and rotation.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget to easily compare two images using a slider with a draggable line and handle. Supports custom line styles, zooming, panning, rotation, and size matching.
use_when: You need to visually compare two images side-by-side or overlaid with a slider.
Users need to zoom, pan, or rotate the compared images synchronously.
avoid_when: You need complex multi-image carousels or image galleries without comparison features.
strengths: Supports zoom, pan, and rotation with an optional controller.
Highly customizable handles, divider lines, and builders for wrapper effects.
Handles different image sizes and aspect ratios automatically.
weaknesses: Limited strictly to comparing two images.
data.setup_notes: No native permissions or special configuration needed.
data.minimal_example:
ImageCompareSlider(
  itemOne: const Image.asset('assets/image_one.png'),
  itemTwo: const Image.network('https://example.com/image_two.png'),
)
